text: Dzień dobry, od rana czuć gaz w kuchni, zapach jest coraz silniejszy. Mieszkanie 3, 41 Hollins Street. Proszę o pilny kontakt.
notes: Polish: 'since this morning there is a smell of gas in the kitchen, getting stronger'. 'gaz' is not the English keyword; the rule may miss it, the AI must catch it.
